verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers is purpose-built for edge compute: docs explicitly describe deploying to Cloudflare's global network with no servers/regions to manage, Smart Placement for latency optimization, and community reports corroborate fast, easy deployment close to users. Minor caveats exist (some CPU-time limits noted by community for long-running tasks) but the core story is strongly delivered with both first-party and hands-on evidence. missing for 10: independent latency benchmarks across regions, and no discussion of edge network size/PoP count.
